basic_info.description: 1102 Mason Street is 5 unit apartment corner building superbly located in the Nob Hill District of San Francisco, one of the consistently most popular rental and tourist neighborhoods. The building was constructed in 1909 and has been owned by the same family since 1948. Unit mix includes one 3 bedroom/1 bathroom flat and four 2 bedroom/1 bathroom flats. The corner three bedroom flat would make for a wonderful owner's unit with an eat-in kitchen with retro banquette seating and separate living room. The units have ample sized kitchens and bedrooms and boast lovely natural light due to the building's corner location. The units are separately metered for gas and electricity. Tenants pay for heat and hot water. Soft story seismic work is completed. This is an excellent investment or owner/user opportunity in a fabulous neighborhood with significant upside!
